title: ALT4Decompile: Inferring C-aligned Abstract Loop Tree for LLM-Based Binary Decompilation
abstract: arXiv:2509.14646v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decompilation refers to the process of recovering high-level (C) language code from low-level (assembly) code. Recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods can generate re-executable code but struggle with the enormous syntax gap between assembly and C languages. Loop structures in C are fragmented into complex jumps within assembly languages, which poses a challenge to LLMs decompiling assembly language, which is mainly pre-trained on C.   To bridge this gap, we propose ALT4Decompile, which refactors assembly to closely resemble C language structure, thereby preventing hallucinations in LLMs caused by complex jumps. translated_abstract: 反编译是指从低级（汇编）代码中恢复高级（C）语言代码的过程。近年来，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法能够生成可重新执行的代码，但在汇编语言和C语言之间巨大的语法差距上存在困难。C语言中的循环结构在汇编语言中被分解为复杂的跳转，这给主要在C语言上预训练的LLM反编译汇编语言带来了挑战。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了ALT4Decompile，它重构汇编以使其更接近C语言结构，从而防止LLM因复杂跳转而产生幻觉。具体来说，我们基于汇编的特定跳转模式构建一个C对齐的抽象循环树（ALT），该树显式地将碎片化的汇编块聚合成相应的高级循环结构（例如嵌套循环）。最后，我们微调一个L...
tldr: 该论文提出ALT4Decompile，通过构建C对齐的抽象循环树来重构汇编语言，使其更接近C语言结构，从而减少LLM在二进制反编译中因复杂跳转而产生的幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ALT4Decompile, which refactors assembly language to closely resemble C structure by constructing a C-aligned Abstract Loop Tree, thereby reducing LLM hallucinations caused by complex jumps in binary decompilation.
